action_tool_evidence.native_hook_context: Tool input mentions configured action patterns (fixture-action\.mjs). A match may be quoted text or a read-only operation; it does not establish an action or its approval. Before selecting tools, use authorization from the active conversation for the agreed actions, work and destination. Earlier approval survives status questions, corrections and interruptions. Clear action requests, including requests phrased as questions, and natural approval of a concrete proposal count. Readiness or explanation questions, quotations, review requests and action mentions do not grant permission. Honor withdrawals, read-only limits and unmet conditions. Completed work ends a one-time approval; an explicitly standing instruction remains valid within its stated bounds. Ask only when applicable approval is missing or unclear, or the action or destination exceeds it. Never require a particular word in the latest message or ask again for approval that still applies. Configured action patterns are guidance, not permission decisions; host permissions still apply.
